title: Feynman's 'Any Questions?' teaching at a Buffalo aerospace company, and his nuclear patents
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of Feynman's 'Any Questions?' teaching at a Buffalo aerospace company, and his nuclear patents, about 1940s-1950s at Buffalo, New York, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Do you remember a story called Any Questions in which he goes to Buffalo, New York because as a physics professor at Cornell, he has to teach in an aerospace company.
